The FloPlast 68mm round downpipe socket in black offers a practical, easy to install solution for rainwater drainage systems. Constructed from durable uPVC, this standard downpipe socket is ideal for both new-build construction projects and refurbishment applications, ensuring efficient water flow from guttering. It requires no lubrication for fitting, saving time on site. This reliable plumbing component helps maintain proper exterior drainage, making it suitable for general building work and property maintenance.
